scope: Consolidate existing Git blob and STUN SHA-1 core without changing either protocol or admission policy.
preservation: Private Git helper has one production caller in publisher blob verification. It retains format!("blob {}\0", bytes.len()).into_bytes(), appends the same bytes, and uses existing lowercase hex encoding.
Private NAT SHA-1 helper is used by unchanged HMAC key normalization, inner hash and outer hash. STUN_MI_LEN remains 20. It retains Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len() + 72) followed by extend_from_slice.
Shared helper consumes the callers existing Vec, without an additional payload copy. Allocation and usize addition behavior at each wrapper remain unchanged.
Shared body is byte-identical to the old NAT padding/compression/output body apart from the owned-buffer signature and constant STUN_MI_LEN expressed as 20.
Original model indexed assignment and shared zip initialize exactly the first 16 schedule entries for every 64-byte chunk; all remaining entries are zero before expansion.
Length conversion and wrapping multiplication, padding, round operation order and wrapping additions, big-endian word decoding and 20-byte output are retained.
HMAC body and original inline test modules are byte-identical. Model admission, hashing selection, error paths and existing public APIs remain unchanged.
Both consumers already depend on susi-paths. No dependencies or manifest changes in this slice. New shared API is used by both consumers.

validation.detail: 110 existing tests and 3 new compatibility tests; doctests 0.
Existing external publisher-metadata qualification remains explicitly ignored.
Includes RFC 3174, RFC 2202 HMAC and RFC 5769 TURN long-term key cases.

differential.corpus: Padding boundaries, all lengths0..1024,65536and1millionbytes,5000seededbinary cases with key lengths0/1/16/63/64/65/80/128. Finite corpus, not exhaustive proof.

independent_review.result: No findings. Verified exact shared body, wrapper allocation/framing, HMAC and test-tail preservation, schedule initialization equivalence, wrapping and endian behavior. Reviewer made no edits or builds.

coordination.publication: Parent serializes integration and publication; this worker did not push.

limits: This is a 43-line runtime reduction, not completion of the under-100,000-line goal.
Differential corpus is finite and not an exhaustive proof. Independent Python references cover actual old/new extracted raw, Git-framed and HMAC functions.
Validation is native Linux only. No Windows, macOS, CUDA, Metal, MKL, release promotion or production qualification claim.

Tests and lint ran before unrelated upstream release metadata, requirement tests and push-policy updates were fast-forwarded. None of the three affected packages or their dependency source changed in that update.
No primitive or security policy change; no cryptographic-strength claim.
